item.title: WWE Clash in Italy 2026 Livestream: How to Watch Cody Rhodes vs. Gunther Live Online

[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we're getting ready to rumble with the WWE Clash in Italy 2026. I'm your host, and I'm excited to break down the details of this highly anticipated event.
[Short music transition]
Host: So, when and where is the Clash in Italy taking place? The answer is this Sunday, May 31st, at the Inalpi Arena in Turin, Italy. The event kicks off at 2 p.m. ET, or 11 a.m. PT, with coverage starting at 1:30 p.m. ET.
[Short music transition]
Host: Now, if you're wondering how to watch the Clash in Italy online, you can catch it exclusively on ESPN Unlimited. The streaming service offers a wide range of sports content, including every ESPN network, for just $29.99 per month. And, if you're not a subscriber, don't worry – we've got you covered with a workaround to access ESPN Unlimited for free.
[Short music transition]
Host: But that's not all. If you're outside the US, you can also stream the event live on Netflix with the help of a VPN, such as ExpressVPN. This means you can watch the Clash in Italy from anywhere in the world.
[Short music transition]
Host: So, who's on the match card for the Clash in Italy? We've got some exciting matchups, including Cody Rhodes defending his Undisputed WWE Championship title against Gunther, Rhea Ripley vs. Jade Cargill for the WWE Women's Championship, and Roman Reigns vs. Jacob Fatu in a Tribal Combat Match.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today, folks. Don't miss the WWE Clash in Italy 2026, live on ESPN Unlimited or Netflix with a VPN. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the flip side.
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
